portal.unavailable: The report is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
portal.expired: Your session has ended. Please log in again.

verify.validText: This report was issued by Meridian Diagnostics (Demo) and is the current version.
verify.supersededText: This report was replaced by a newer, amended version. Ask the patient for the latest report.

verify.rateLimited: Too many checks from this connection. Please try again in a few minutes.

portal.prepLede: Some tests need fasting or other preparation. Check before you come.
